author: caffeinated_boi
body:
1. Activity slots from the Allegiance Points shop have a 1 week duration, I think it's always been the case. It's the same with Astral Tree's activity slots.

2. All event bosses spawn in their corresponding paths in monuments (yes, you can sometimes get the thief boss in warrior's path etc but that rarely happens, they usually stick to their own). 3 new rare monsters (Ramesses, Medjed and Golden Kheper) are also monument exclusive.

3. The higher prices are probably for when you buy all the previous rewards and you simply want more of the same kind. First, cheaper prices are the easy way out and later on it's probably better to get the items from other sources rather than allegiance points.

3. Different events have different allegiance rewards, we will have to wait for any of them to come back to see if the rewards stay the same or if they change to something else.

5. Pretty sure the event "codex" still exists in the event hub. You have to select the event you're interested in and it should be there in one of the tabs. Breakdown of all monsters/bosses/raids and their items

author: X-pectruM
body: Sorry to ask this here, but I've been wondering for a while. What does the Extra activity slots exactly do? Also noticed that most of the content is in monuments this time, but as a T9 I can't seem to find anything worthwhile, the shades are too low lvl...

author: ExcitingTurn6381
body:
As others have said, the activity slots are one week. Which is absurd and means they’re a waste of time that can be skipped.  The event XP this month is quite awful compared to other months, since monuments are rare, only have 12 floors, and spawn very few event mobs. The only way to get significant event XP is by engaging in the most useless and unrewarding activity in the entire game: killing world mobs

Not a huge fan.  These bosses should clearly spawn in regular dungeons too. The cost of items from allegiance points doesn’t make sense without a reliable way of getting the XP. I doubt we will see a change though
